parsed_response.explanation: The agent misunderstood the task by returning only the introduction years instead of the names of the roller coasters associated with those years.
parsed_response.evidence: The question asks to 'Name the introduction years of the 6 oldest roller coasters'. The agent's final answer is `[1884 1895 1896 1901 1902 1904]`, which are only the years, not the names of the roller coasters.
